name: vasp-band-gap
description: Calculate the band gap (and band structure) of a crystalline material from a CIF file using DFT/VASP on the HPCSlurmArm cloud cluster. Implements the MatterGen paper protocol (microsoft/mattergen#213): MP-GGA double relax → static SCF → non-scf uniform → non-scf line, all orchestrated through the jcc CLI. Use this skill whenever the user mentions band gap, band structure, PBE gap, HSE gap, direct/indirect gap, optical absorption edge, VBM/CBM, electron eigenvalues, or asks "is this material a semiconductor / metal / insulator" given a crystal structure. Also triggers for batch band-gap calculations on multiple CIFs, or when the user references the MatterGen band-gap recipe specifically. The skill reads a CIF, writes 5 VASP job directories, submits them in sequence to the cloud, and parses vasprun.xml to report gap_eV + direct/indirect + VBM/CBM.
